Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1220
Claimant:
Julia Price
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
04/14/2023
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped at a traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
05/28/2023
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the impact occurred as the insured described and admitted fault for
following too closely. Police report obtained and lists the claimant as an occupant of the striking vehicle.
06/24/2023
Reviewed photos from the scene and the insured's own images; the rear bumper damage and the trunk lid
deformation are largely consistent with the reported impact speed. No prior damage to this vehicle is on file.
06/28/2023
Two independent witnesses gave statements that match the sequence of events described by both drivers. Neither
witness had any connection to the parties involved.
07/18/2023
Claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact. The injury pattren is consistent with bracing against the dashboard
or wheel during a collision of this force, and no prior injury to that wrist or arm appears in the records requested.
07/23/2023
Medical records received from the treating facility show a standard course of care: immobilization, a follow-up
orthopedic visit, and physical therapy. Traetment tapered as the claimant's range of motion improved.
08/24/2023
Counsel's office provided a written summary of the claimant's account. It matches the recorded statement given
earlier and the description given at the scene, with no material differences in the sequence or details.
09/11/2023
Confirmed with the policy file that the driver of the insured vehicle lives in the policyholder's household and is listed as
a covered household member. Coverage was in force on the loss date, and nothing in the file suggests the damage
predates the policy start.
10/04/2023
Medical bills and the repair estimate have been reviewed against the damage described. Charges are in line with
usual rates for the treatment provided, and the repair scope matches the visible damage in the photos.
11/24/2023
Follow-up with counsel scheduled to request the complete imaging file and the physical therapy notes. No additional
documentation issues identified at this stage.
11/30/2023
File remains open pending receipt of the remaining records and the final repair invoice. Reserve reviewed and
maintained at the current level until treatment is confirmed complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
